response.sql:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS base
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
grp AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
above AS (
  SELECT g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - b.base AS excess
  FROM grp g
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE g.grp_avg > b.base
)
SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS mean_group_avg,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: A missing announcement timing is a NULL eventannotm; GROUP BY places all NULLs in one group of their own.
Each group's average and the baseline ignore NULL instownpct values, as AVG does. A group whose instownpct values are all NULL has no average and is excluded because NULL > baseline is not true.
The baseline is the AVG over all individual snapshots with non-NULL instownpct, including snapshots whose eventannotm is NULL, so it weights larger groups more.

'Mean of their averages' is the unweighted mean across the qualifying groups' averages, and 'mean amount exceeding the baseline' is the mean of each qualifying group's (average minus baseline). Both are returned in one row without rounding.
